rootDecisions: Accept the complete-snapshot, single-writer identity-only protocol and all candidate fail-closed policies in the proposal; not a raw source registry or Gate A closure.

New SourceId starts IdentityEpoch=1 even if initially ambiguous; all initially ambiguous SourceIds appear in InvalidatedBindingSourceIds. Later confidence/device identity transitions increment epoch once.
Same-source collision entry/exit invalidates binding but does not revoke SourceId; genuine lifecycle/descriptor changes revoke the previous SourceId.
Current-source immutable entries determine CatalogRevision; inactive-only history updates with unchanged empty/current snapshot do not alone increment it.

The adapter must supply genuine unique object tokens and monotonic invalidation/usage stage revisions; no OS event coalescing, Unity runtime, mapping, profile, calibration or application wiring is implemented here.
expectedVerification: Strict pure compilation, author tests then independently authored reference transitions and three compiled mutations; existing resolver/router/touch remain byte-unchanged.
